case_number: 2024 INSC 851; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 12233 OF 2024 (ARISING OUT OF SLP (C) NO. 5589 OF 2024)
summary: IBC vs arbitration invocation; Section 9 IBC petition invalid when arbitrable dispute exists; withdrawal of Section 11 application improper; pre-existing dispute admitted; Section 11(6) relief distinct from Section 9 IBC; Order 23 Rule 1 CPC inapplicable; sole arbitrator appointment valid.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; NCLT and High Court orders set aside; arbitration proceedings directed; IBC application dismissed.
